calibration: Per league, train both R14 hurdles on pre-date R7 input anchors in 2015/16–2016/17. For validation and test use the R10 independent r7-control.json selection and fitted R7 distribution. The 2017/18 validation alone chooses score, WDL and total doses. Test 2018/19 once. No fitted parameters from modern R14.
cold_start: Sources join only to supplied independent calendar beginning in 2015/16.
eligibility: Both source sides must be uniquely identified. Each statistic needs a valid own value and agreeing opponent mirror. Pressing uses only raw paired integer att >= 0, def > 0. Unpaired source team rows occupy their actual last-eight calendar slots without metrics. Every original test fixture remains eligible for scoring.
source_clock: Unzoned Understat source calendar day. No historical publication timestamp.
source_identity: No provider IDs or opponent column. R10 ordered fixture names and league/date, with unique normalized names, documented league aliases or prior calendar links. Exact source timestamp agreement and one-to-one use of both source rows required.
